answer: Say a registry admits 1 new wallet per sponsor per 10 epochs, and the sponsor locks 30 POA in an onyx escrow for 25 epochs. An attacker with N fakes needs N sponsors, so N=1 costs 30 POA and N=200 locks 6,000 POA, which cannot be reused across sponsors. Each epoch a raven committee of 5 random validators audits 1 in 6 new wallets and writes the verdict to a public ledge log. Honest users lock 30 POA once and appeal within 5 epochs for a refund. It fails if sponsors collude at scale.
